name: Silver Telecom
summary: Sydney business telecom/ISP (silvertelecom.com.au -> silverconnect.com.au); business name 'OFFICELINK PLUS & SILVER TELECOM' registered by OfficeLink Plus Pty Ltd; brand an AKA of Anittel's network.

refs.label: 2009 silvertelecom.com.au page embeds silverconnect.com.au — same operation
PeeringDB confirms OfficeLink+ AKA Silver Telecom identity

events.details: Brand absorbed into the Anittel web; parent entity cancelled 2014. Absorbed into Anittel and the operating company deregistered ~Jun 2011 per ASIC gazette A027/11 - both current and proposal (2014) are too late.

refs.label: ASIC gazette of 5 Apr 2011 lists Silver Telecom Pty Ltd (ACN 110 105 667) for deregistration in two months - company deregistered ~Jun 2011, not 2014.
By Apr 2011 only a residual support page (prior evidence) - brand already absorbed.
PeeringDB confirms Silver Telecom became part of Anittel's network (later Superloop).
